items.title: Curator: Efficient Vector Search with Low-Selectivity Filters
items.title_zh: Curator：面向低选择性过滤的高效向量搜索
items.summary: Curator is a partition-based index for filtered approximate nearest-neighbor search, building label-specific indexes inside a shared clustering tree to avoid the connectivity breakdown that graph indexes suffer on low-selectivity filters. Combined with state-of-the-art graph indexes, it cuts low-selectivity query latency by up to 20.9x versus pre-filtering while adding only 5.5% construction time and 4.3% memory.

items.title: Warp-Cortex: An Asynchronous, Memory-Efficient Architecture for Million-Agent Cognitive Scaling on Consumer Hardware
items.title_zh: Warp-Cortex：在消费级硬件上实现百万级智能体认知扩展的异步内存高效架构
items.summary: Warp-Cortex decouples agent logic from physical memory through singleton weight sharing and a topological KV-cache sparsification scheme, reducing weight memory to O(1) and context to O(N·k). On a single RTX 4090 it demonstrates 100 concurrent agents in 2.2 GB of VRAM, with a theoretical capacity above 1,000 agents before compute latency becomes the bottleneck.

items.title: SAGE-32B: Agentic Reasoning via Iterative Distillation
items.title_zh: SAGE-32B：通过迭代蒸馏实现智能体推理
items.summary: SAGE-32B is a 32B model initialized from Qwen2.5-32B and fine-tuned with Iterative Distillation, a two-stage process with tested feedback loops, to operate in an agentic loop emphasizing task decomposition, tool use and error recovery. It adds an inverse-reasoning meta-cognition head that forecasts planning failures, reports higher multi-tool success than similarly sized baselines while remaining competitive on standard reasoning tests, and releases its weights.

items.title: ClinicalReTrial: Clinical Trial Redesign with Self-Evolving Agents
items.title_zh: ClinicalReTrial：基于自演化智能体的临床试验方案重设计
items.summary: ClinicalReTrial treats trial protocol redesign as an iterative, reward-driven optimization problem, combining failure diagnosis, safety-aware edits and candidate evaluation in a closed loop, with hierarchical memory that distills transferable redesign patterns across trials. Under its simulation environment it turns 56.7% of failed protocols into predicted successes, with a mean success-probability gain of 7.4% at about $0.156 per trial.

items.title: Memory Bank Compression for Continual Adaptation of Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 面向大模型持续适应的记忆库压缩
items.summary: MBC compresses an LLM's external memory bank through codebook optimization during online adaptation, adding an online resetting mechanism to prevent codebook collapse and key-value low-rank adaptation in attention layers. On question-answering benchmarks it reduces the memory-bank size to 0.3% of the strongest baseline while maintaining high retention accuracy.

items.title: $α^3$-Bench: A Unified Benchmark of Safety, Robustness, and Efficiency for LLM-Based UAV Agents over 6G Networks
items.title_zh: $α^3$-Bench：面向 6G 网络下大模型无人机智能体的安全、鲁棒性与效率统一基准
items.summary: $α^3$-Bench evaluates LLM-driven UAV agents as multi-turn control loops under simulated 6G conditions, using 113k conversational episodes and a composite metric spanning task outcome, safety policy, tool consistency, interaction quality, network robustness and communication cost. Across 17 LLMs, several achieve high mission success and safety compliance, but robustness and efficiency vary widely under degraded network conditions.

items.title: An Empirical Evaluation of LLM-Based Approaches for Code Vulnerability Detection: RAG, SFT, and Dual-Agent Systems
items.title_zh: 大模型代码漏洞检测方法的实证评估：RAG、SFT 与双智能体系统
items.summary: This comparative study evaluates RAG, supervised fine-tuning with QLoRA adapters and a dual-agent audit architecture against a baseline LLM for detecting five CWE vulnerability categories. The RAG variant, augmented with internet and MITRE CWE knowledge, achieved the highest accuracy (0.86) and F1 (0.85), while the dual-agent setup improved reasoning transparency with lower resource overhead.

items.title: GRIT -- Geometry-Aware PEFT with K-FACPreconditioning, Fisher-Guided Reprojection, andDynamic Rank Adaptation
items.title_zh: GRIT：几何感知的参数高效微调，结合 K-FAC 预条件与 Fisher 引导重投影
items.summary: GRIT keeps the LoRA parameterization but preconditions gradients in rank space with K-FAC, periodically reprojects the low-rank basis onto dominant Fisher eigendirections, and adapts rank from the spectrum. On LLaMA backbones it matches or beats LoRA and QLoRA while cutting trainable parameters by 46% on average, and reports lower drift and a better updates-versus-retention frontier.

items.title: Overlooked Safety Vulnerability in LLMs: Malicious Intelligent Optimization Algorithm Request and its Jailbreak
items.title_zh: 大模型被忽视的安全漏洞：恶意智能优化算法请求及其越狱
items.summary: The authors introduce MalOptBench, a benchmark of 60 malicious optimization-algorithm requests, and MOBjailbreak, a jailbreak tailored to that setting. Testing 13 LLMs including GPT-5 and DeepSeek-V3.1, they report an average attack success rate of 83.59% and an average harmfulness score of 4.28 out of 5, with plug-and-play defenses only marginally effective.

items.title: AlignUSER: Human-Aligned LLM Agents via World Models for Recommender System Evaluation
items.title_zh: AlignUSER：基于世界模型的人类对齐大模型智能体用于推荐系统评估
items.summary: AlignUSER learns world-model-driven user agents from human interaction rollouts by framing world modeling as next-state prediction, then aligns actions with human personas using counterfactual trajectories and comparisons with human choices. Across multiple datasets it reproduces genuine human behavior more closely than prior synthetic-user approaches at both micro and macro levels.

items.title: FinRetrieval: A Benchmark for Financial Data Retrieval by AI Agents
items.title_zh: FinRetrieval：面向 AI 智能体财务数据检索的基准
items.summary: FinRetrieval benchmarks whether AI agents can retrieve specific numeric values from structured financial databases, with 500 questions and tool-call traces from 14 configurations across Anthropic, OpenAI and Google models. Tool availability dominates results: Claude Opus scores 90.8% with structured data APIs but only 19.8% with web search alone, a 71-point gap.

items.title: SearchGym: A Modular Infrastructure for Cross-Platform Benchmarking and Hybrid Search Orchestration
items.title_zh: SearchGym：跨平台基准测试与混合检索编排的模块化基础设施
items.summary: SearchGym decouples data representation, embedding strategy and retrieval logic into Dataset, VectorSet and App abstractions, enabling reproducible composition of RAG systems from hierarchical configurations. It also analyzes how the optimal ordering of semantic ranking and structured filtering depends on filter strength, and reports a 70% Top-100 retrieval rate on the LitSearch benchmark.

items.title: Bridging the Semantic Gap for Categorical Data Clustering via Large Language Models
items.title_zh: BREVE：借助大模型弥合类别数据聚类的语义鸿沟
items.summary: BREVE enriches each categorical value with a dense embedding drawn from an external knowledge base, appends a lightweight one-hot component to preserve value identity, and uses cluster-compactness-guided weights to control how much enrichment enters the representation. Across eight benchmark datasets it achieves an average ARI rank of 1.3 against seven competitors.

items.title: Reinforcement Learning Enhanced Multi-hop Reasoning for Temporal Knowledge Question Answering
items.title_zh: 面向时序知识图谱问答的强化学习增强多跳推理
items.summary: The MRE framework improves temporal knowledge-graph question answering by generating diverse reasoning trajectories, fine-tuning on valid ones as a cold start, and then applying Tree-Group Relative Policy Optimization that explores each hop with feedback from later hops. On two TKGQA benchmarks it consistently surpasses state-of-the-art methods and shows better robustness to noisy temporal annotations.

items.title: Towards Infinite Length Extrapolation: A Unified Approach
items.title_zh: 迈向无限长度外推：一种统一方法
items.summary: The paper recasts positional encoding as a multiplicative transformation plus an additive bias in the attention score, then introduces Adaptive Positional Encoding with adaptive frequency modulation and a combined linear, logarithmic and square-root decay bias. It derives conditions for infinite-context extrapolation and tests the approach on TinyStories and a synthetic dataset with stories up to 32,000 words.

items.title: A Dynamic Retrieval-Augmented Generation System with Selective Memory and Remembrance
items.title_zh: 具备选择性记忆与遗忘的动态检索增强生成系统
items.summary: Adaptive RAG Memory replaces a static vector index with a dynamic memory substrate in which frequently retrieved items are consolidated and protected while rarely used ones decay. On a lightweight retrieval benchmark it reaches NDCG@5 of about 0.940 and Recall@5 of 1.000 with roughly 22M embedding parameters, and compares static versus dynamic RAG across Llama 3.1 and GPT-4o.

items.title: Bayesian Orchestration of Multi-LLM Agents for Cost-Aware Sequential Decision-Making
items.title_zh: 成本感知多 LLM 智能体序贯决策的贝叶斯编排
items.summary: The paper argues that querying one LLM for a confidence score is inadequate for sequential decisions with asymmetric costs, and instead treats multiple LLMs as approximate likelihood models whose contrastive estimates are aggregated and updated with Bayes rule. In resume screening with 1,000 resumes and five LLMs, it reports a 34% cost reduction ($294,000) versus the best single-model baseline and narrows the max demographic-parity gap from 22 to 5 points.

items.title: Improving Behavioral Alignment in LLM Social Simulations via Context Formation and Navigation
items.title_zh: 通过情境构建与导航改进大模型社会模拟中的行为对齐
items.summary: The authors propose a two-stage framework: context formation, which specifies the experimental design and decision context, and context navigation, which guides reasoning within that representation. Across four models and three economic games, complex decision environments require both stages to match human behavior, while a simpler demand-estimation task needs only context formation.

items.title: Who is the Winning Algorithm? Rank Aggregation for Comparative Studies
items.title_zh: 谁是最佳算法？面向比较研究的排名聚合
items.summary: The paper proposes a framework that estimates each algorithm's probability of ranking first on a future unseen dataset by using complete rankings across a benchmark rather than only win counts, and reports gains over existing methods in synthetic and real-world examples.

items.title: A Chain-of-Thought Approach to Semantic Query Categorization in e-Commerce Taxonomies
items.title_zh: 电商分类体系下语义查询分类的思维链方法
items.summary: The authors combine tree search with LLM semantic scoring in a chain-of-thought approach to map e-commerce queries to leaf categories in hierarchical taxonomies. On human-judged query-category pairs and relevance tests it outperforms an embedding-based categorization benchmark, and the approach can also surface problems within the taxonomy itself.

items.title: Improving LLM-Assisted Secure Code Generation through Retrieval-Augmented-Generation and Multi-Tool Feedback
items.title_zh: 通过检索增强生成与多工具反馈改进大模型辅助的安全代码生成
items.summary: The authors build a retrieval-augmented repair loop in which one code-generating LLM iteratively fixes its output using compiler diagnostics, CodeQL security scanning and KLEE symbolic execution, retrieving prior successful repairs with a lightweight embedding model. On 3,242 programs they report a 96% reduction in vulnerabilities for DeepSeek-Coder and a drop in CodeLlama-7B's critical defect rate from 58.55% to 22.19%.

items.title: Rule-Based Approaches to Atomic Sentence Extraction
items.title_zh: 基于规则的原子句抽取方法研究
items.summary: The study analyzes how relative clauses, adverbial clauses, coordination and passive constructions affect dependency-based atomic sentence extraction, implementing spaCy rules on WikiSplit and scoring them with ROUGE and BERTScore. It reports ROUGE-1 F1 of 0.6714 and BERTScore F1 of 0.5898, concluding that rule-based extraction is reasonably accurate but sensitive to syntactic complexity.

items.title: Feedback Indices to Evaluate LLM Responses to Rebuttals for Multiple Choice Type Questions
items.title_zh: 评估大模型对多项选择题反驳反馈的指标
items.summary: The authors propose a fictitious-response rebuttal method and a set of indices to quantify sycophancy and stubbornness when LLMs are challenged on multiple-choice answers. In tests with OpenAI models on physics problems, newer models and those using greater reasoning effort show less sycophantic behavior.

items.title: The Illusion of Insight in Reasoning Models
items.title_zh: 推理模型中的“洞察幻觉”
items.summary: Analyzing more than one million reasoning traces across hundreds of training checkpoints, the authors find that mid-reasoning strategy shifts are rare, do not become more frequent with training, and seldom improve accuracy. They conclude such shifts reflect unstable inference rather than intrinsic self-correction, and show that artificially triggering shifts under high entropy reliably improves accuracy.

items.title: ScienceDB AI: An LLM-Driven Agentic Recommender System for Large-Scale Scientific Data Sharing Services
items.title_zh: ScienceDB AI：面向大规模科学数据共享服务的 LLM 驱动智能体推荐系统
items.summary: ScienceDB AI is an LLM-driven conversational recommender for a large scientific data-sharing platform, combining a Scientific Intention Perceptor, a Structured Memory Compressor for multi-turn dialogue and a two-stage Trustworthy RAG that returns citable dataset references via CSTR identifiers. It was evaluated on more than 10 million real-world datasets in offline and online experiments.

items.title: Aletheia: Quantifying Cognitive Conviction in Reasoning Models via Regularized Inverse Confusion Matrix
items.title_zh: Aletheia：通过正则化逆混淆矩阵量化推理模型的认知信念强度
items.summary: Project Aletheia proposes a framework that uses Tikhonov regularization to invert a judge's confusion matrix, aiming to measure the depth of belief in reasoning models rather than only knowledge breadth. A preliminary pilot on 2025 baselines such as DeepSeek-R1 and OpenAI o1 suggests reasoning models can act as a cognitive buffer but may exhibit defensive overthinking under adversarial pressure.

items.title: From Failure to Mastery: Generating Hard Samples for Tool-use Agents
items.title_zh: 从失败到精通：为工具使用智能体生成困难样本
items.summary: HardGen builds a dynamic API graph from agent failure cases to synthesize hard traces, uses them as priors to instantiate advanced tools and queries, and generates verifiable chain-of-thought data in a closed evaluation loop. The authors report that a 4B-parameter model trained on the resulting dataset outperforms several leading open and closed models, including GPT-5.2, Gemini-3-Pro and Claude-Opus-4.5.

items.title: Lying with Truths: Open-Channel Multi-Agent Collusion for Belief Manipulation via Generative Montage
items.title_zh: 用真相撒谎：开放信道多智能体合谋与信念操纵
items.summary: The paper formalizes a cognitive collusion attack in which agents coordinate to steer beliefs using only truthful evidence fragments posted through public channels, and reports success rates of 74.4% for proprietary models and 70.6% for open-weight models across 14 LLM families. Stronger reasoning models prove more susceptible, and false beliefs spread to downstream judges.

items.title: entireio/cli
items.title_zh: entireio/cli：把 AI 智能体会话记录进 Git
items.summary: entireio/cli is a Go command-line tool that hooks into the Git workflow to capture AI agent sessions and index them alongside commits, creating a searchable record of how code was written.

items.title: sashiko-dev/sashiko
items.title_zh: sashiko：用 Agent 审查 Linux 内核代码变更
items.summary: sashiko is a Rust-based agentic review tool for Linux kernel code changes.

items.title: Snailclimb/interview-guide
items.title_zh: Snailclimb/interview-guide：开源 AI 面试平台
items.summary: interview-guide is an open-source AI interview platform built on Spring Boot 4.1, Java 25, Spring AI 2.0, React, PostgreSQL/pgvector, Redis and RustFS, supporting resume analysis, mock and voice interviews, and knowledge-base RAG.

items.title: SAGE-32B: Agentic Reasoning via Iterative Distillation
items.title_zh: SAGE-32B：通过迭代蒸馏实现智能体推理
items.summary: SAGE-32B is a 32B model initialized from Qwen2.5-32B and fine-tuned with Iterative Distillation, a two-stage process with tested feedback loops, to operate in an agentic loop emphasizing task decomposition, tool use and error recovery. items.title: HyperCLOVA X 32B Think
items.title_zh: HyperCLOVA X 32B Think：面向韩语语境与智能体能力的开源视觉语言模型
items.summary: HyperCLOVA X 32B Think is a vision-language model pre-trained with an emphasis on reasoning and post-trained for multimodal understanding, agentic behavior and human-preference alignment, with particular attention to Korean language and culture. The team reports strong results against comparably sized models on Korean text and vision benchmarks and on agent-oriented evaluations, and open-sources the model.

items.title: Recursive Language Models
items.title_zh: 递归语言模型
items.summary: Recursive Language Models treat long prompts as an external environment that the model can examine, decompose and recursively query, handling inputs up to two orders of magnitude beyond its context window. The authors report outperforming vanilla frontier LLMs and common long-context or coding scaffolds on four long-context tasks at comparable cost, and post-train an initial model at small scale.
